concepts.def: Decisive battle on 14 October 1066 where William of Normandy defeated King Harold Godwinson, killed by an arrow according to the Bayeux Tapestry.
Hierarchical land-holding pyramid: king grants land to barons for knight service; peasants worked land for protection.
Comprehensive land survey ordered by William I recording landholders, livestock and value for taxation across England.
Early Norman wooden castle design: raised mound (motte) with keep, enclosed courtyard (bailey) below for garrison.
William's brutal campaign destroying villages and crops in Yorkshire and Durham after rebellion; caused mass famine.
Harsh Norman laws reserving woodlands for royal hunting; punishments included blinding for poaching deer.
